# US-004 — Update conformance suite, CI workflow, documentation, and version bump

**Story:** US-004
**Task:** T-004 (status: done)
**Priority:** P2
**Spec:** SPEC-014 FR15, FR16, FR17, FR18, NFR4

---

## Who this affects

Plugin maintainers and contributors who run the conformance suite in CI, and anyone reading the project's public documentation. This story closes out SPEC-014 by aligning tests, CI, docs, and the version number with the shipped behavior.

## What was done

### Conformance fixtures

All 9 SPEC-013 wave-based fixtures (`conformance/fixtures/parallel-dispatch-G1/` through `G9/`) were deleted. Four new native-dispatch fixtures were created:

| Fixture | What it asserts |
|---------|-----------------|
| `native-dispatch-nd1-parallel` | 6 independent tasks dispatch in 1 turn; no `Agent` call carries `isolation` |
| `native-dispatch-nd2-advisory-locklist` | Two tasks sharing `package.json` are NOT serialized; advisory note is present in the prompt but enforces nothing |
| `native-dispatch-nd3-dependson` | A task with `dependsOn: [T-A]` is deferred until T-A is `done`; the full run takes 2 turns |
| `native-dispatch-nd4-per-task` | Codex `per-task`, Cursor `per-task`, and Claude Code `single-task` each emit exactly 1 `Agent` call per invocation |

`conformance/runner.mjs` was rewritten (net change ~1401 lines): SPEC-013 wave/worktree/serialization assertion functions removed, replaced with ND1–ND4 assertion functions.

### CI

`.github/workflows/ci-parallel-dispatch.yml` was updated to run the four new ND fixtures. All pass at exit 0.

### Documentation

- `docs/rules.md` — R11 removed (handled by T-002; T-004 verified clean).
- `docs/pipeline-overview.md` — worktree isolation and `--max-parallel` sections replaced with native dispatch description.
- `docs/protocol/runtime-adapters.md` — worktree isolation adapter section replaced.
- `docs/compatibility-matrix.md` — SPEC-013 row updated to reflect SPEC-014 supersession.
- `docs/feat-parallel-dispatch/` — all files rewritten to describe native dispatch contract. `docs/feat-parallel-dispatch/worktree-safety.md` did not exist at HEAD (already absent), so no deletion was needed.

**Note (resolved):** the file was renamed from `us-001-wave-scheduler-core.md` to `docs/feat-parallel-dispatch/us-001-native-dispatch-core.md` so the filename matches its native-dispatch content (the SPEC-013-era "wave-scheduler-core" slug is gone).

### Version bump

- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` version updated from `0.11.0` to `0.12.0`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — 0.12.0 entry prepended: describes the SPEC-013 reversal, lists all removed machinery, lists what was added (`dependsOn` field, ND1–ND4 fixtures), and includes a migration note that `--max-parallel` is gone and that leftover 0.11.0 worktrees can be cleaned with `git worktree remove` / `git branch -D`.
